page: Microsoft Azure E96-24as_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server from the Easv7 family, powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. This configuration features 12 physical cores and 24 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. It is equipped with an exceptionally large memory capacity of 768.0 GB, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 32.0 GB per core. The server does not include local storage or GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the E96-24as_v7 demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, particularly in stress-ng single-core tests, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Its memory subsystem shows strong performance in PassMark memory tests, alongside average multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds with small LLM models.

Given its massive 768.0 GB memory footprint relative to its 24 vCPUs, this server offers high qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require proportional compute scaling. It is highly suited for large in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
